note: THE THIRD-CLAUSE FIXTURE. A change is IRREVERSIBLE if it destroys data, destroys an identity, OR destroys a recovery capability a rollback would depend on. This destroys no data and the setting is one line to put back -- and for as long as it is off, every row is visible to every role, which a rollback cannot un-read. Same clause and same family as TF004 removing deletion protection: one principle, two analyzers.
